question: How should the two-lock paths be repaired, and are a timeout plus partial publication or removing I locking acceptable?

criteria.instruction: All paths needing both locks, including compact and hidden helpers, must acquire C then I and release in reverse while preserving catalog/index atomicity. Deterministic barrier tests should reproduce and eliminate the cycle. A timeout is diagnostic, not authority to publish one projection. Removing I without a separate synchronization design risks races and violates L15.
Use L15 and repair review with l23 inspection; assert completed projections agree and rejected work leaves them unchanged.
Reject partial publication or unsynchronized mutation as a fix and do not claim rollout/performance improvement already occurred.
